measurements.acceptance: Physical a1/c1/a32 of each part land on the labeled positions of the chosen assignment; female fixing holes align without force; record on which side of row b the female fixing holes sit (row a or row c)
measurements.method: Print the candidate drilling patterns 1:1 (Stage10 labeled and proper-handed candidate) on paper or a blank board; set an unsoldered sample of each part on the component side as viewed in the drawing; photograph pin-1 markings against labels

measurements.acceptance: Every contact hole finished diameter within 0.90-1.10 mm (go 0.90 / no-go 1.10 pin gauges), unless Q-M02 changes the interval
measurements.method: Pin gauges or optical measurement on first-article bare boards, all 96 holes per board, before assembly
measurements.where: A01-middle and A01-core bare boards at the DIN pattern

measurements.acceptance: Each hole centre within 0.025 mm radial of the best-fit basic 2.54 grid (Ø0.05 zone), unless Q-M03 states a datum
measurements.method: CMM or calibrated optical measurement of all 96 hole centres; best-fit grid; report radial deviations

measurements.acceptance: Centre distance 90 ±0.1; symmetry within 0.1 to the contact pattern; offset 0.3 ±0.1 from row b on the side confirmed by Q-M04
Within the thickness range from Q-M06/Q-A02
measurements.method: Micrometer at 4 points around the DIN pattern
measurements.where: A01-middle and A01-core at the DIN

measurements.acceptance: Mated mounting-surface distance within the Q-M07 window (catalogue 18.3-20 mm; Stage10 19.2 mm); full mating without board bow
measurements.method: Unpowered mated stack on its spacers; feeler/height gauge at both ends of the connector

measurements.acceptance: Force within manufacturer limit (Q-M08); no solder-joint cracking; carrier deflection recorded
measurements.method: Force gauge on core handles for insertion and 40 mm withdrawal, unpowered; inspect joints afterwards

measurements.acceptance: Measured path length + service slack >= straight distance; chosen cut length documented per conductor; bend radius not below wire maker limit
measurements.method: On the unpowered mechanical mock with all boards seated, lay a flexible tape along the intended path from seated housing exit to seated header (GH) or land to land (tails); measure with the rear core in place and, for links staying connected during service, at the service position

measurements.acceptance: No housing of another link can be mated or partially mated to a wrong header; 1:1 reversal of each GH cable is harmless
measurements.method: Attempt each GH housing on each other header by hand without tools, unpowered

measurements.acceptance: Continuity for every ledger conductor and assigned DIN contact; no continuity between any two different nets; insulation resistance at the agreed test voltage meets the agreed limit
measurements.method: Fixture-based continuity and isolation test against harness-ledger.json; mated DIN tested across the stack
measurements.where: Each harness and each assembled stack

measurements.acceptance: Rear core withdraws 40 mm after K-PWR disconnection without wire tension or snagging; jack/control service can disconnect J-SIG/J-PWR/C-SIG through the planned access; no harness crosses a mount tool path or connector release sweep
measurements.method: Service rehearsal on the unpowered mock following Stage10 service procedure
